name: pr-autopilot
description: Polls GitHub for new reviews/comments and CI results on this session's PR and asks Claude to address them

mcpServer.title: General: MCP server
mcpServer.description: BBGitHub MCP server name, as /mcp lists it

intervalSeconds.title: General: Interval seconds
intervalSeconds.description: How often each session checks; the poller's request rate

feedbackAutomationEnabled.title: Feedback: Automation enabled
feedbackAutomationEnabled.description: Whether new reviews and comments on your PR are sent to Claude. Feedback that arrives while this is off is never sent.

feedbackSkill.title: Feedback: Feedback skill
feedbackSkill.description: Skill Claude is told to use for PR feedback: its name (my-pr-feedback) or its folder (~/.claude/skills/my-pr-feedback).

feedbackTriggerOnlyInRealTime.title: Feedback: Trigger only in real time
feedbackTriggerOnlyInRealTime.description: What happens to feedback posted while no Claude session is running for that PR's branch. false: it waits, and the next Claude session started on the branch will immediately start processing it. true: it's skipped.

ciAutomationEnabled.title: CI: Automation enabled
ciAutomationEnabled.description: Whether CI results on your PR are sent to Claude. CI that finishes while this is off is never sent.

ciSkill.title: CI: CI skill
ciSkill.description: Skill Claude is asked to use for CI results, given the same way as feedbackSkill

ciTriggerCadence.title: CI: Trigger cadence
ciTriggerCadence.description: When CI results are sent. onAllChecksFinish: one prompt once every check on the PR's latest commit has finished. onSingleCheckFinish: a prompt each time a check finishes

onlyTriggerWhenCiFailed.title: CI: Only trigger when failed
onlyTriggerWhenCiFailed.description: true: CI results are sent only when a check failed (failure, error, timed_out, action_required). If onAllChecksFinish is set to true and some checks failed, ALL checks and their statuses are sent to Claude. false: pass check status to Claude whether they passed or failed.

ciTriggerOnlyInRealTime.title: CI: Trigger only in real time
ciTriggerOnlyInRealTime.description: What happens to CI results that arrive while no Claude session is running for that PR's branch. false: they wait, and the next Claude session started on the branch will immediately start processing them. true: they're skipped.
